tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// nyi ma dang zla ba'i mdo bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sūrya sū tra/ bod skad du/ nyi ma'i mdo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so// de'i tshe lha'i bu nyi ma lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis bzung ngo*// de nas lha'i bu nyi mas/ bcom ldan 'das rjes su dran pa yid la byas te/ de'i dus su tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to// sangs rgyas dpa' bo de la 'dud// thams cad myur du grol bar gyis// bdag 'di'i kha ru bcug pa na// bdag ni khyed la skyabs su mchi// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu nyi ma'i ched du/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin la tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la brtse bas// dgra bcom de bzhin gshegs pa la// nyi ma skyabs su song ba na// sgra gcan 'dzin gyis ci ma thongs/ gang zhig mun pas snang bas gsal bar byed// rnam snang drag po'i gzi brjid dkyil 'khor can// nam mkha'i nyi ma sgra gcan sgrib ma byed// nyi ma 'di ni sgra gcan gyis thongs shig /de nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis lha'i bu nyi ma grol bar byas nas sngar gyi gzugs bzhin du/ gang su zhig gis lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris kyi drung du song nas/ sems mi dga' zhing yid mug pas ba spu langs par gyur te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin la/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris kyis tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ ci phyir yid ni skrag par gyur// sgra gcan 'dzin gyis nyi ma thong*// gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur kun tu ngan// ci phyir 'jigs pas 'di ru lhags// des smras pa/ sangs rgyas tshigs bcad thos nas ni// bdag gis nyi ma ma btang na// mgo bo tshal pa bdun 'gas shing*// 'tsho ba la ni bde ba med// nyi ma'i mdo rdzogs so/// /paṇḍi ta chen po ā nanta shrī'i zhal snga nas/

mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// sa'i steng du nyi ma dang zla ba ltar gyur cig// /zhus dag// / ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsand+ra sū tra/ bod skad du/ zla ba'i mdo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so// de nas de'i tshe lha'i bu zla ba lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis bzung nas/ de nas lha'i bu zla bas/ bcom ldan 'das rjes su dran pa yid la byas te/ de'i dus su tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsol to// sangs rgyas dpa' bo de la 'dud// thams cad myur du grol bar gyis// bdag 'di'i kha ru bcug pas na// bdag ni khyed la skyabs su 'gro// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu zla ba'i ched du/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin la tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la brtse bas// dgra bcom de bzhin gshegs pa la// zla ba skyabs su song bas na// sgra gcan 'dzin gyis zla ba thongs// de nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis/ lha'i bu zla ba grol bar byas nas/ sngar gyi gzugs bzhin du gang su zhig gis lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris kyi drung du song nas/ sems mi dga' zhing yid mug pas ba spu langs par gyur pas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ yang lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin la/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris kyis tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ ci phyir yid ni skrag par gyur// sgra gcan 'dzin gyis zla ba thongs// gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur kun tu ngan// ci phyir 'jigs pas 'di ru lhags// sgra gcan 'dzin gyis smras pa/

sangs rgyas tshigs bcad thos nas ni// zla ba bdag gis ma btang na/ mgo bo tshal pa bdun 'gas shing*// 'tsho ba la ni bde ba med// zla ba'i mdo rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta chen po ā nanta shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/// /
